shortcut.title: iOS Shortcut
shortcut.intro: The Shortcut reads steps, active energy and distance from Apple Health and sends them here on a schedule — no app to install. Sending the same day again just updates the numbers.
shortcut.sync_hint: When the Shortcut last sent data
shortcut.token_hint: This token can only send health data — it cannot read or change anything else. Revoke it under “API tokens”.
shortcut.body: Request body — JSON with the fields
shortcut.body_hint: The date is optional: the server uses your today. Numbers can be sent as they are — “8 342” and “6,2” work too.
shortcut.step_1: Tap “Create token” above and copy it.
shortcut.step_2: Shortcuts → “+” → action “Find Health Samples”: type Steps, start date today. Then “Calculate Statistics” → Sum.
shortcut.step_3: Repeat for “Active Energy” and “Walking + Running Distance”.
shortcut.step_4: Add “Get Contents of URL”: the URL above, method POST, the Authorization header, a JSON body with the three fields — values from steps 2 and 3.
shortcut.step_5: Run the Shortcut once by hand: the line at the top of this screen will say “just now”.
shortcut.step_6: Automation → Time of Day → 13:00, and another one at 22:00 → Run Immediately.
shortcut.extra_sleep: Sleep: bed_at and wake_at (date and time)
shortcut.extra_hint: Same token and header. Weight and sleep can also be entered by hand on Today.
shortcut.manual: If the Shortcut fails, steps can be typed in on Today — nothing depends on the Shortcut.

rules.intro: XP comes from logging and from the day's targets — it only ever goes up. Default values:
rules.nutrition: meal logged +{{meal}} (up to {{meals}} a day — for logging, never for restricting) · protein target +{{protein}}* · fiber target +{{fiber}}* · water target +{{water}} · calories in the zone +{{kcal}} per finished day
rules.movement: step target +{{steps}} · workout +{{workout}} (up to {{workouts}} a day) · personal record +{{record}} (up to {{records}} a day)
rules.planner: task P1 +{{p1}} · P2 +{{p2}} · P3 +{{p3}} · P4 +{{p4}}, subtask +{{subtask}} (up to {{cap}} a day) · project completed +{{project}} · timer +1 per {{minutes}} min (up to {{timerCap}} a day)
rules.bonus: “Score 60+” streak — {{list}} · quests — their reward once you claim it · achievements — their reward, once
rules.floor_note: * Only when the day's intake is at or above the safe floor. Eating below the floor or not logging never brings XP, score points or streaks.
rules.burned_note: Burned calories never become food budget.
rules.window_note: Today's and yesterday's XP is recalculated: delete an entry and its XP goes too. Quest, achievement and streak rewards stay for good.

notion.what: DisciplineOS can copy your tasks, projects, areas, journal and daily summaries to Notion. It creates the databases itself on a page you choose.
notion.one_way: Your data stays in DisciplineOS; Notion gets a copy every 10 minutes. Edits made in Notion are overwritten by the next sync — change things in the app.
notion.one_way_short: One-way copy: edits made in Notion are overwritten by the next sync.
notion.step_create: Open the Notion Developer portal → Internal connections → “Create a new connection”, name it (e.g. DisciplineOS) and pick your workspace.
notion.step_capabilities: On the Configuration tab turn on Read content, Update content and Insert content, then copy the API token — that is the secret.
notion.step_page: Create an empty page in Notion, e.g. “DisciplineOS” — the databases will appear on it.
notion.step_share: On that page tap ⋯ (top right) → Connections → Add connection and pick your connection.
notion.step_paste: Copy the page link (⋯ → Copy link) and paste it below together with the secret.
notion.secret_hint: The API token from the Configuration tab. Stored encrypted on the server and never shown again.
notion.page_hint: The page you gave the connection access to.
notion.secret_privacy: The secret goes only to your DisciplineOS server and is used only for requests to Notion.
notion.kinds_hint: A section switched off stops updating; its database and pages stay in Notion.
notion.db_missing: The database was deleted or unshared in Notion — create it again
notion.running: Syncing — copying your data to Notion…
notion.partial: Not everything fit into one run — the next sync continues.
notion.pending: Pages being checked: {{count}} — verified on the next sync.
notion.failed_rows: Pages Notion refused: {{count}}. Retried when they change.
notion.interrupted: The last sync was interrupted (the server restarted). Start it again.
notion.auto: The server syncs on its own every {{minutes}} min.
notion.disconnect_body: Syncing stops and the secret is deleted from the server. Everything already copied to Notion stays there.
notion.disconnected_toast: Notion disconnected. Your data in Notion stays.
